description: This file defines the LinkConnector interface, which extends LinkDecoder, and provides a static anonymous class implementation called VOID with no-op method implementations, as well as method declarations for network connection management.

classes.name: LinkConnector
classes.description: A Java interface defining the contract for a link connection, including methods for connection management, message sending, error checking, and unpacking data.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection and registers a connection state listener.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command string over the link, optionally firing an event.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if the link has encountered an error.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a received packet string using the TEXT_PROTOCOL_DECODER.
